decision.reason: [ev-a907ed2193a8] is a single bug-fix line saying terminationGracePeriod RBAC permissions were added. It does not name the role, resource, verb or API group, and it does not say which environments lacked them or what failed. The proposed exposure, a change to the rules of any ClusterRole, is broader than this change, because any unrelated RBAC rule change in 1.0.0 would also match it. The render validator could not find this permission in either rendered chart, so no artifact confirms the condition. Deciding this would need the PR #6538 diff (the exact ClusterRole and rule added) and a statement of what failed without that rule.
